note: Light trigger check set: should-trigger phrasings about a company's operations (SOPs and process design, program and project plans, vendors and procurement, logistics) and about the user's own life (household routines, errands, travel, moves, contractors), and near-miss negatives a neighbouring department owns, phrased close to this one's. Used by the description trigger check.
should_trigger: write an SOP for how we onboard new wholesale accounts
map our order fulfillment process and find where it slows down
build a project plan for our warehouse move with owners and milestones
help me pick between these three packaging suppliers for my company
our supplier keeps missing delivery dates, what should we do about them
set up a vendor scorecard for the bakery's flour supplier
what's on the critical path for opening our second store
document our returns process so anyone on the team can run it
we keep running out of stock at the shop, fix our reorder process
plan the switch to a new shipping carrier for our online store
plan our move to Denver at the end of next month with a timeline and checklist
plan a two-week trip to Japan for the two of us: itinerary, bookings and a packing list
our mornings are chaos, fix the routine so the kids get to school on time
set up a weekly cleaning and laundry routine the whole household will actually follow
batch my errands this Saturday so I'm not driving all over town
get three quotes for a kitchen remodel and help me pick the contractor
we keep running out of groceries and toilet paper, set up a restock system for the house
the roofer keeps pushing back the start date, how do I hold them to the schedule

review my new apartment lease before I sign it
set next year's budget for the warehouse
how much should we budget for the move and the deposit
set up single sign-on and a help desk tool for our staff
set up the Wi-Fi and the smart lock in our new apartment
hire two warehouse associates and write the job descriptions
help me build a sleep and exercise routine I can stick to
research which third-party logistics providers operate in Germany
brainstorm ways we could cut our shipping costs
independently verify the SOP the ops team wrote before we adopt it
define how we calculate on-time delivery for every dashboard
chart our on-time delivery rate by month
a customer says their order arrived damaged, write them a reply
the airline lost my bag on the trip, write the complaint and get me compensated
